info.name: ReadTrack API
info.description: End-to-end checks for the in-memory ReadTrack API. Run from an empty server state to verify CRUD and reading activity behavior.

exec: pm.test('Book is created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('bookId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('Books are returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Book details are returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('bookId')); });

body.raw: {"title":"Postman API Test Book","author":"ReadTrack QA Updated","genre":"Testing","totalPages":50,"pagesRead":10,"status":"Reading","description":"Updated through Postman."}

exec: pm.test('Book details are updated', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().author).to.eql('ReadTrack QA Updated'); });

item.name: Increase progress — logs only new pages

exec: pm.test('Only the newly read pages are logged', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().activity.pages).to.eql(10); });
pm.test('A correction does not create reading activity', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().activity).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Revisit previous progress — no duplicate activity

exec: pm.test('Previously counted pages are not counted again', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().activity).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('Favourite is toggled', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().isFavorite).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Malformed IDs return 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Unknown books return 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('Bookmark is created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('bookmarkId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('Book bookmarks are returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('All bookmarks are returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Bookmark is updated', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().page).to.eql(46); });
pm.test('Out-of-range pages return 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Bookmark is deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test('Wishlist item is created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('wishlistId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('Duplicate wishlist item returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('Wishlist is returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Wishlist item is moved to the library', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('Want to Read'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('movedBookId', pm.response.json().id);

item.name: Create temporary wishlist item for delete

exec: pm.test('Second wishlist item is created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('deleteWishlistId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('Wishlist item is deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test('Current goal is returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().dailyTarget).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Daily target is updated', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().dailyTarget).to.eql(35); });

pm.test('Goal progress is calculated from activities', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().dailyTarget).to.eql(35); pm.expect(pm.response.json().pagesRead).to.be.at.least(34); pm.expect(pm.response.json().remainingPages).to.eql(Math.max(0, 35 - pm.response.json().pagesRead)); });

pm.test('Weekly pages and streak are returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().days).to.have.length(7); pm.expect(pm.response.json().streak).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Reading activity history is returned', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Daily target can be reset', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().dailyTarget).to.eql(30); });
pm.test('Moved test book is deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test('Test book is deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
